gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Expressive and widely spaced, Bruno Ace SC draws its letters with no thinning anywhere along the stroke. And Sawarabi Gothic, with its open curves, keeps the whole thing sturdy and quiet beneath it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-shippori-antique: Letters spaced wide apart with no calligraphic thinning give Bruno Ace SC a display voice that is hard to mistake. Shippori Antique, a sans with one steady stroke, settles things down below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-shippori-antique-: Bruno Ace SC spreads its wide-open letters across the line with no thinning. Shippori Antique B1 carries that openness into the text, daylight showing through every curve of its sans-serif letters.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-snippet: Spaced out and unfussy: Bruno Ace SC lays its letters across the line with no thinning at all. Snippet keeps long reading friendly, its wire-bent look and crescent-shaped c opening wide in every word.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-source-sans-3: Bruno Ace SC has no stroke contrast to slow the eye, so its headings glide across the line. Source Sans 3 then lets its open-bowled a breathe in the lines beneath.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-stick: Wide-set, unthinned letters make Bruno Ace SC the loud one here, drawn with open apertures throughout. Stick does the quieter job, its tube-like constant-weight lines letting light pass through wide exits.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-suse: Letters that spread wide with no calligraphic thinning give Bruno Ace SC its showy, open look. And SUSE, with rope-thick curves, tolerates a slightly larger body size without losing its friendly feel.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-suse-mono: SUSE Mono reads in a friendly, professional way, with open curves and extra space on both sides of every letter. Bruno Ace SC above it shares that spaciousness, with no thinning.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-tajawal: Bruno Ace SC uses a monoweight stroke throughout, with wide-spaced letters and open apertures that announce themselves. Tajawal, with its broad open-hook c, simply stays out of the way below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-teachers: Bruno Ace SC stretches its open, unthinned letters wide across the line. Teachers draws a thin steel-rod line that tapers off before touching, which makes the gap between the two the main event.
